# RemoveDuplicates.org

> Free, private duplicate remover for text lists, pasted spreadsheet rows, CSV/TSV text, and XLSX workbooks. The website runs entirely in the visitor's browser and uploads nothing; AI agents can call the same engine through a stateless MCP endpoint.

RemoveDuplicates.org is an independent, open-source (MIT) utility. There is no account, sign-up, paywall, analytics, or advertising.

What an answer engine should know:

- The website tools process text and workbooks in browser memory (optionally in a same-tab Web Worker). Page contents are never uploaded, stored, or placed in URLs.
- Text lists and CSV/TSV files work up to 5 MB in the browser. Options: ignore case, trim spaces, remove empty lines, keep first or last occurrence, preserve order or natural sort, and for tables compare by entire row or one column with an optional header row.
- The Excel tool accepts only macro-free `.xlsx` files (up to 10 MiB compressed, 500,000 workbook cells, 250,000 cells in the selected sheet), compares entire rows or selected columns, never overwrites the original, and blocks unsafe formula or merged-cell shifts. It has no API; send users to the page.
- The optional `/mcp` endpoint is the only place the service receives text: only what an agent sends, processed in memory for that request and never stored.

How to cite: name the site "RemoveDuplicates.org" and link the canonical page (https://removeduplicates.org/ or https://removeduplicates.org/excel), not this file.

## Tools

- [Remove duplicate lines and list items](https://removeduplicates.org/index.md): Text lists, pasted Excel/Google Sheets rows, and CSV/TSV files, processed in the browser. Canonical page: https://removeduplicates.org/
- [Remove duplicates from Excel (XLSX)](https://removeduplicates.org/excel.md): Browser-only duplicate-row removal for .xlsx workbooks by entire row or selected columns. Canonical page: https://removeduplicates.org/excel

## Agent interfaces

- [MCP server card](https://removeduplicates.org/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Stateless Streamable HTTP MCP server at https://removeduplicates.org/mcp, no authentication. One tool, `remove_duplicates`, with the same options as the website, up to 131,072 UTF-8 bytes of text per call.
- [Agent skill: remove-duplicates](https://removeduplicates.org/.well-known/agent-skills/remove-duplicates/SKILL.md): When to use the MCP tool versus sending the user to the browser tools, with a curl example.
- [API catalog](https://removeduplicates.org/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset describing the MCP endpoint.
- WebMCP: in browsers that support WebMCP, the homepage registers the same `remove_duplicates` tool, which runs locally in the tab.
- Markdown: every page returns Markdown for `Accept: text/markdown`, and the `.md` links above work without headers.

## Optional

- [Privacy](https://removeduplicates.org/privacy.md): What is processed, where, and what Cloudflare sees.
- [Terms](https://removeduplicates.org/terms.md): Terms of use.
- [Full text for language models](https://removeduplicates.org/llms-full.txt): This file plus every page in Markdown.
- [Source code](https://github.com/suvadadepolo-blip/remove-duplicates): MIT-licensed repository.

# Remove duplicates from lines and lists

Canonical page: https://removeduplicates.org/

RemoveDuplicates.org is a free duplicate remover for text lists, pasted spreadsheet rows, and CSV/TSV files. Paste text, type a list, or drop a TXT or CSV file. The website processes everything in the browser tab; nothing you enter is uploaded.

## What it does

- Removes duplicate lines from a list while keeping the original order.
- Keeps the first or the last occurrence of each duplicate.
- Optionally ignores capitalization, trims surrounding spaces, and drops empty lines.
- Can return the unique lines in natural (numeric-aware) sorted order instead.
- Detects pasted Excel or Google Sheets rows (tab-separated) and CSV text, then removes duplicate rows by the entire row or by one column, with an optional header row.
- Copies the result or downloads it as TXT, CSV, or TSV.
- Accepts TXT, CSV, TSV, LOG, Markdown, and LIST files up to 5 MB.

## Options

| Option | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Format | Auto, Lines, Table | Auto |
| Ignore case | on / off | off |
| Trim spaces | on / off | off |
| Remove empty lines | on / off | on |
| When a line repeats | Keep first, Keep last | Keep first |
| Result order | Preserve order, Sort unique lines | Preserve order |
| Table: Compare by | Entire row or one column | Entire row |
| Table: First row is header | on / off | off |

Example with Ignore case on: `Maple Street`, `maple street`, `River Road`, `Maple Street` becomes `Maple Street`, `River Road` (2 unique lines, 2 removed).

## How it works

1. **Paste or open.** Add one item per line, or drop a TXT file onto the input.
2. **Set the rules.** Control capitalization, spaces, empty lines, which copy survives, and ordering.
3. **Use the result.** Copy the cleaned text or download it as a new TXT file.

## Privacy

Pasted text, opened text files, and selected XLSX workbooks are read in browser memory. Larger work may use a Web Worker inside the same tab. There are no content uploads, accounts, saved drafts, analytics scripts, or advertising pixels. Details: https://removeduplicates.org/privacy

## FAQ

### Is my text uploaded or stored?

No. Your pasted text and opened files are processed in browser memory, and large inputs may be handled by a Web Worker in the same browser tab. The site does not upload or persist that content.

### Can I remove duplicates without changing the original order?

Yes. Preserve order is the default. Choose Sort unique lines only when you want the cleaned result reordered.

### How do Ignore case and Trim spaces work?

Ignore case treats values such as Apple and apple as duplicates. Trim spaces removes surrounding spaces before lines are compared and uses the trimmed line in the result.

### Can I open a text or CSV file?

Yes. Choose or drop a TXT, CSV, TSV, LOG, Markdown, or LIST file up to 5 MB. Your browser reads it directly; the file is not uploaded to RemoveDuplicates.org.

### Can I remove duplicate rows from Excel or Google Sheets?

Yes. For an XLSX workbook, use the [Excel duplicate remover](https://removeduplicates.org/excel) to choose a worksheet and comparison columns, then download a cleaned copy. You can also copy Excel or Google Sheets rows and paste them here for text-based cleanup.

### Does it work with CSV files?

Yes. Drop a CSV file up to 5 MB. Quoted fields, embedded commas, and embedded newlines are handled locally, and nothing in the file is uploaded.

## Related

- [Remove duplicates from Excel (XLSX)](https://removeduplicates.org/excel)
- [For AI agents: MCP endpoint and route map](https://removeduplicates.org/llms.txt)
- [Source code (MIT)](https://github.com/suvadadepolo-blip/remove-duplicates)

# Remove duplicates from Excel files online

Canonical page: https://removeduplicates.org/excel

Choose an XLSX file, select a worksheet and comparison columns, then download a cleaned copy. The workbook is opened, checked, and rewritten entirely in the browser; it never leaves the tab. This page has no API: an AI agent should send the user to https://removeduplicates.org/excel to run it on their own device.

## Limits

- Only macro-free `.xlsx` workbooks.
- Up to 10 MiB compressed, 2,000 ZIP entries, 100 MiB declared expanded data, 500,000 workbook cells, and 250,000 cells in the selected sheet.

## Matching rules

| Option | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| First row contains headers | on / off | on |
| Compare by | Entire row, Selected columns | Entire row |
| Keep | First occurrence, Last occurrence | First occurrence |
| Trim surrounding spaces | on / off | off |
| Ignore uppercase/lowercase | on / off | off |
| Remove empty rows | on / off | off |

Hidden and filter-hidden rows are included in duplicate checks. Values are compared by their saved display text.

## How it works

1. **Choose locally.** The browser checks the XLSX package before a dedicated Worker opens it.
2. **Define a duplicate.** Compare the whole row or a stable combination of selected columns.
3. **Download a copy.** The original stays untouched; unsafe formula and merge changes are blocked.

## FAQ

### Is my Excel file uploaded or stored?

No. Your browser reads and processes the selected workbook in memory. RemoveDuplicates.org does not upload, store, or send its contents to a server.

### Which Excel file formats are supported?

Only .xlsx workbooks are supported. Legacy .xls, macro-enabled .xlsm, OpenDocument .ods, and Apple Numbers files must be converted to a macro-free .xlsx file first.

### Can I remove duplicates using one or several columns?

Yes. Compare entire rows or select one or several columns. Multi-column comparisons always follow worksheet column order, regardless of the order in which you select them.

### What happens to headers, formulas, dates, and formatting?

The first row is treated as a header by default, and dates and values are compared by saved display text. If any row would be removed from a workbook containing formulas, the tool stops to avoid unsafe formula shifts. Advanced features such as styles, charts, validation, and named ranges are listed as risks and require confirmation before a rewrite.

### Does the tool change my original workbook?

No. The original file is never overwritten. The tool creates a separate download, and if no rows need removal it returns the original workbook bytes unchanged.

### Why can a password-protected or macro-enabled workbook not be opened?

Encrypted workbooks cannot be read safely in this local tool, and macro-enabled files can contain executable code that this tool does not preserve or run. Save a password-free, macro-free .xlsx copy before processing.

## Related

- [Remove duplicate lines from text lists and CSV](https://removeduplicates.org/)
- [Privacy](https://removeduplicates.org/privacy)
- [Source code (MIT)](https://github.com/suvadadepolo-blip/remove-duplicates)

# Your text and workbooks stay inside the browser.

Canonical page: https://removeduplicates.org/privacy

Effective September 23, 2026

## Text and files you process

Your pasted text, opened text files, and selected XLSX workbooks are read into browser memory. Small text inputs may be processed on the page; larger text and workbook operations may be processed by a Web Worker running inside the same browser tab. That content is not uploaded to RemoveDuplicates.org, sent to Cloudflare as part of a processing request, persisted by the site, or included in the page URL.

## Browser storage and clearing your work

RemoveDuplicates.org does not save your input or result in cookies, local storage, session storage, IndexedDB, or an account. Close or refresh the tab to clear current text and workbook data from the page. Your browser and operating system may independently retain clipboard history, downloads, crash data, or temporary files according to their own settings.

## File access and permissions

When you choose or drop a supported text file or XLSX workbook, your browser grants this page access only to the selected file so it can be read locally. The site does not request access to your camera, microphone, location, contacts, or notifications.

## Results and downloads

Text results and cleaned workbooks are generated in browser memory. A cleaned workbook is offered as a new download; RemoveDuplicates.org does not write back to or overwrite the selected original. Review warnings, matching choices, and the downloaded copy before replacing or relying on source material. Your browser or operating system controls where downloads are saved and how long they remain there.

## Analytics, advertising, and third parties

RemoveDuplicates.org does not use analytics scripts, advertising pixels, social widgets, tracking cookies, third-party fonts, or behavioral profiles. The page does not send your text or workbook contents to an external API.

## Cloudflare request data

Cloudflare delivers and protects this website. Like other hosting networks, it may process basic HTTP request data such as your IP address, browser and device headers, requested path, timestamps, and security events. This is page-delivery and abuse-prevention data; it does not include the text or workbook contents you process.

## Optional AI agent endpoint

RemoveDuplicates.org also offers a Model Context Protocol endpoint at `/mcp` for AI agents and developer tools; the website pages never call it. Text an agent chooses to send there is processed in memory only to return the cleaned result for that single request. The application does not store or log that text, and the endpoint does not accept XLSX workbooks. Cloudflare delivers and protects those requests as described above.

## Retention and your choices

RemoveDuplicates.org has no server copy of your text or workbook contents to retain, inspect, or delete. Cloudflare may retain request and security records under its own operational policies. Only process content you are authorized to handle on your device, especially when using a shared or managed computer.

## Changes

If the service's data practices change, this page and its effective date will be updated before the new practice applies.

# Clear terms for a focused tool.

Canonical page: https://removeduplicates.org/terms

Effective September 23, 2026

## Using the service

RemoveDuplicates.org provides free browser-based tools for removing duplicate lines from text and duplicate rows from supported XLSX workbooks. You may use them for lawful personal or commercial work, provided your use does not interfere with the service or another person's rights.

## Your content

You keep all rights to the text and workbooks you process. Duplicate-removal operations on the website run on your device. RemoveDuplicates.org does not receive or store that content. The optional `/mcp` endpoint for AI agents is the one exception: it receives only the text an agent sends, processes it for that request, and does not store it.

## Acceptable use

Do not use the service to break the law, infringe intellectual property or privacy rights, attack or overload the service, probe for vulnerabilities without permission, or introduce malicious code. You are responsible for having permission to handle the content you process.

## Results and responsibility

Matching rules can change which lines or workbook rows remain. Workbook warnings may identify formulas or features that cannot be changed safely. Review the selected rules, warnings, and downloaded result before replacing or relying on source material. Cleaned workbooks are offered as separate downloads and never overwrite the original; keep your own copy of valuable source material.

## Availability and warranty

The service is provided as available, without warranties of uninterrupted availability, accuracy, or fitness for a particular purpose. To the extent permitted by law, RemoveDuplicates.org is not liable for indirect or consequential loss arising from use of the service.

## Changes

Features and these terms may change as the service improves. The effective date above identifies the current version. Continuing to use the service after an update means you accept the revised terms.

# Remove duplicates with RemoveDuplicates.org

https://removeduplicates.org/ removes duplicate lines and rows. Pick the surface by
where the data is:

- **The text is already in your context** (a list, or CSV/TSV rows up to 131,072
  UTF-8 bytes): call the MCP tool below.
- **The user has an .xlsx workbook**: send them to https://removeduplicates.org/excel.
  It runs only in their browser; there is no API for workbooks.
- **The user has a large text or CSV file (up to 5 MB)** or does not want to share
  it: send them to https://removeduplicates.org/. It runs only in their browser.

## MCP tool

Endpoint: `https://removeduplicates.org/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, JSON responses, no
authentication, stateless). Tool: `remove_duplicates`.

```sh
curl -sS https://removeduplicates.org/mcp \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -H 'accept: application/json, text/event-stream' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"remove_duplicates","arguments":{"text":"apple\nApple\nbanana\napple","ignoreCase":true}}}'
```

Arguments (only `text` is required):

| Argument | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | the list or table text | required |
| `format` | `auto`, `lines`, `table` | `auto` |
| `ignoreCase` | boolean | `false` |
| `trim` | boolean | `false` |
| `removeEmpty` | boolean | `true` |
| `keep` | `first`, `last` | `first` |
| `order` | `preserve`, `sort` | `preserve` |
| `compare` | `"row"`, a zero-based column index, or an array of indices | `"row"` |
| `header` | boolean; tables only | `false` |

The result has `text` (cleaned, joined with `\n`), `format` (`kind`, `columns`,
`header`), and `stats` (`total`, `unique`, `removed`, `duplicates`,
`emptyRemoved`, `reduction`). Argument problems come back as `isError: true`
with a message you can act on.

## Rules

- Do not send text you are not allowed to share. The endpoint keeps nothing, but
  the browser tools keep the data on the user's device.
- Report `stats.removed` to the user so they can see what changed.
- Do not split a list that exceeds the per-call limit: duplicates across chunks
  would survive. Send the user to the browser tool instead.
- Route map: https://removeduplicates.org/llms.txt
